evidence: DomainEventCollector stores events only in a Python list and drains them.

confirmed_gap_register.impact: A crash after database commit can lose integration intent; duplicate delivery and replay cannot be governed.

evidence: repository.add and repository.update_status commit internally.

confirmed_gap_register.impact: The abstraction does not provide atomic application service, audit and event persistence or reliable rollback.
confirmed_gap_register.work: Move commits out of repositories, implement explicit transaction boundaries/context manager and atomically persist aggregate, audit reference and outbox record.

evidence: DisputeRepository.create_schema executes CREATE TABLE and conditional ALTER TABLE at runtime.

evidence: Dispute records and repository updates show no aggregate version/ETag/If-Match field.

evidence: GET `/disputes` returns all records without visible pagination/filter/limit controls.

evidence: The current gateway is deliberately in-process/mock.

controls.requirement: Requirements → architecture decisions → generated code → tests → evidence → operations/retirement must be linked and machine-checkable.
Generate stakeholders, concerns, viewpoints, bounded contexts, decisions, trade-offs and synchronized diagrams/models.
Define measurable requirements for functionality, performance, compatibility, interaction, reliability, security, maintainability, flexibility and safety.
Enforce dependency boundaries, complexity budgets, architectural rules and technical-debt evidence.
Each generated service has explicit responsibility, data ownership, APIs/events, dependencies and independent tests.
Use optimistic concurrency, idempotency and explicit consistency boundaries; use outbox/inbox and compensation where workflows cross services.
Generate OpenAPI 3.1+ with truthful tooling version, operation IDs, examples, security schemes, pagination and compatibility evidence.
All generated API errors use application/problem+json-compatible stable types, status, title, detail, instance and correlation extensions.
When eventing is justified, generate AsyncAPI and a portable envelope; otherwise record a reasoned not-applicable decision.
Target ASVS Level 2 and maintain a measurable SAMM improvement plan with evidence, exclusions and risk ownership.
Verify object/function/property authorization, resource limits, inventory, SSRF, unsafe consumption and secure defaults.
Generate an identity/authorization adapter contract and deterministic local test issuer; production issuer integration remains optional and gated.
Generate SLIs/SLOs/error budgets plus timeout, retry, jitter, circuit-breaker, bulkhead, rate-limit and degraded-mode policies.
Distinct startup, liveness and readiness probes; graceful drain/shutdown and restart/recovery tests.
Correlated logs, metrics and traces with stable service/resource attributes and safe cardinality.
Expose OpenMetrics/Prometheus-compatible counters/histograms using base units, _total suffixes and bounded labels.
Unit, component, integration, provider/consumer contract, end-to-end, security, migration, restart and operational acceptance tests.
Use deterministic fuzz/property/mutation/model-based tests where they materially improve confidence.
Local repeatable smoke/load tests with percentile, concurrency and resource budgets; no production-capacity claim from laptop results.
Pinned/locked reviewed dependencies, source restrictions, license evidence, update policy and minimal runtime footprint.
Produce and validate CycloneDX and SPDX representations for factory and each generated deliverable.
Produce verifiable source/build provenance and verification summaries without claiming a SLSA level unless all requirements are satisfied.
Normalize timestamps/order/metadata, rebuild twice, compare hashes and explain unavoidable variance.
Typed policy decisions, scope-bound approval, nonce/replay protection and fail-closed protected-action enforcement.
Adopt declarative/versioned/reconciled principles for delivery evidence only where useful; Kubernetes and continuous deployment remain unnecessary.
Multi-application isolation for state, ports, process ownership, quotas and evidence before any full multi-tenant productization.
Measure delivery and recovery without gaming metrics and correlate with quality/reliability.
Runbooks, rollback, incident timeline, recovery objectives, ownership and provider-neutral well-architected review.
Versioned prompts/schemas/tools, bounded loops, least privilege, independent verification, no silent self-modification and explicit protected-action approvals.
Capability depth without mandatory Kubernetes, mesh, Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL or cloud services; native and container routes stay first-class.

engineering_recommendations: Do not split the current reference application into many processes merely to call it microservices. First create one production-grade service blueprint and prove service-boundary extraction through contracts and independent runtime tests.

Use SQLite + transactional outbox + local dispatcher as the default lightweight event architecture. Kafka should remain an optional adapter only when throughput/order/retention requirements justify it.
Use typed native policy modules and JSON schemas first. Add OPA only if cross-language policy reuse or external decision-service requirements emerge.

Adopt Twelve-Factor principles selectively: externalized config, disposability and port binding are useful; treating logs only as ephemeral streams conflicts with the factory's evidence/audit requirements, so immutable audit evidence remains separately retained.
Use GitOps principles for declarative, versioned desired state and verification, but do not add Kubernetes, continuous reconciliation or automatic deployment.
Generate a deterministic local OAuth/OIDC test issuer/profile rather than depending on Keycloak or a cloud identity service. Keep production identity as a port/adaptor contract.
Require every new capability to prove generator propagation, fresh generated-app behavior, self-contained tests, evidence and recipient replay; factory-only implementation does not close a gap.

phase_71_82_plan.disposition: Dated benchmark registry, control-to-evidence matrix, deterministic validator, drift detection and quality score. This is the first gate.
Generate a lightweight microservice kernel: lifecycle, RFC 9457, identity port, migrations, transaction boundary, outbox/inbox, health, telemetry and resilience.
Retain payment/domain capability packs only when contracts, ownership, tests and version compatibility are explicit. Avoid a plugin marketplace.
OpenAPI/AsyncAPI, OAuth/OIDC, timeout/retry budgets, mock adapters and provider/consumer contract tests. Live integrations stay prohibited.
Implement app/version/process/state/evidence isolation and quotas now. Do not add tenant billing, shared identity infrastructure or database-per-tenant complexity without a real requirement.
Agents may inventory, score and recommend remediation across applications, but may not autonomously merge, push, release, deploy or delete.
Use before/after evaluation, bounded repairs, regression evidence and rollback. Prohibit silent prompt/model/policy self-modification.
Prompt injection, poisoned retrieval, malformed tool output, replay, stale evidence, failure injection, resource abuse and supply-chain tamper tests.
Build/package/promote/rollback contracts and local/Compose replay. Deployment remains disabled until explicit approval; Kubernetes is not required.
Produce RBI/PCI/ISO/DPDP mapping and evidence registers with explicit gaps and non-claims. No certification or regulator approval assertion.
Diagnostics, restart suggestions, evidence collection and safe local actions may be automated; impactful remediation and protected actions remain human-gated.
Fresh-clone generation, multiple requirements, native and optional Docker replay, security/supply-chain review, benchmark score, recipient operation and immutable closure.

strengths_to_preserve: The public repository already implements deterministic-first operation, explicit approvals, immutable identities, evidence hashes, mock-only integrations and fail-closed non-claims.
The reference generated application has clear domain/application/infrastructure seams through CQRS objects, ports, repository and unit-of-work abstractions.
SQLite is a justified lightweight default for local-first operation and can support production-quality transaction/outbox semantics for the intended constrained runtime.
The generated application already implements client-request and business-level duplicate detection and returns an idempotent replay for identical submissions.
Runtime configuration prohibits live providers and real secrets and constrains persistence paths.
The repository has structured logging, PII-sensitive-key handling and W3C trace-context parsing in factory observability code.
The repository has extensive factory-wide regression, native recipient and Docker/Compose routes, generated test execution, OpenAPI publication and runtime operations evidence.
The current README truthfully states that the project is not production-deployed, certified or approved for real payment movement.
